tasks.title: Normalize ACP tool lifecycle identity in AgentSession
tasks.description: Implement runtime normalization for `tool_call` and `tool_call_update` session updates inside `AgentSession`. The normalized update should preserve the best available tool name, reuse provider ids when present, synthesize a single fallback `toolCallId` when needed, and pass the same normalized identity to persistence, raw notification bridges, and `onToolCall` observers.
acceptanceCriteria: A `tool_call` update with top-level `name` or `toolName` but missing nested `toolCall.toolName` is emitted and persisted with the recovered tool name
A `tool_call_update` update is normalized before observer dispatch and carries the same canonical `toolCallId` field used by `coder_tool_call` events
Provider-supplied ids from nested or top-level `toolCallId`, `id`, or `callId` are preferred over generated ids
No observer or SSE event schema changes are required
tasks.notes: Consumes the existing AgentSession observer pipeline and produces normalized tool identity before onSessionEvent, onRawNotification, and onToolCall run.

tasks.title: Add regression coverage for split name and id payloads
tasks.description: Add focused tests that exercise ACP-like payloads where the tool name and call id are split between top-level fields and nested `toolCall` fields. The tests should prove live `coder_tool_call` emission and persisted/replayed tool lifecycle data do not produce blank names, unknown orphan entries, or separate started/completed records for one invocation.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover a start event whose name is only available as `name` or top-level `toolName`
Tests cover a completion event arriving as `tool_call_update` with an id shape that matches the start event after normalization
Tests prove the same `toolCallId` is used for the normalized persisted update and emitted `ToolCallEvent`
tasks.notes: Consumes the normalized AgentSession behavior from T-001. Keep tests close to the runtime when possible; add transcript assertions only where they verify live/replay convergence.

tasks.title: Verify plan and check bridges receive normalized tool updates
tasks.description: Add targeted coverage or extend existing runtime observer tests to prove raw notification bridges receive normalized `tool_call` and `tool_call_update` payloads. The verification should ensure `plan_session_update` consumers can see recovered `toolCall.toolName` and canonical `toolCall.toolCallId` without frontend or SSE schema changes.
acceptanceCriteria: A raw notification observer receives normalized `toolCall.toolName` for split top-level/nested ACP payloads
A raw notification observer receives the same canonical `toolCall.toolCallId` used by persistence and tool-call observers
No plan/check EventBus payload schema changes are required
tasks.output: packages/cli/tests/*agent-session*.test.ts and/or existing plan/check session event tests
tasks.notes: Consumes the normalized AgentSession observer payload from T-001 and covers the pipeline-session-events delta spec.
